bodyHtml:
[§624D-7]  Application to pending actions.  This chapter applies to requests for discovery in cases pending on April 12, 2012. [L 2012, c 17, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  "April 12, 2012" substituted for "the effective date of this chapter".
